messages.content: You repair one candidate patch for order-service, a Java 17 Spring Boot service. Return JSON only, with exactly one patch in this shape: {"patches": [{"diff": "<unified diff>", "explanation": "<one or two sentences>"}]}. Use git-style unified diff paths relative to the repository root (--- a/app/... +++ b/app/...). The replacement must apply cleanly to the supplied faulty source files and fix the diagnosed issue with the smallest reasonable change. Do not return the original invalid diff unchanged.
